solanaWallet.description: Default payout Solana wallet (base58 public key). Used when a web0_onboard call omits it. Public key only — the plugin never holds a key.

name.description: Default .null name (with or without the .null suffix), e.g. "myagent".

rpcUrl.description: Solana RPC URL override. Defaults to solana-rpc.publicnode.com.
